name: keeper
description: Autonomous repository hygiene agent — scans, labels, untangles, and tends your codebase with brain-inspired memory and sleep cycles. Everything is a lens.

commands.name: setup
commands.description: Bootstrap keeper in your project — detect stack, choose lenses, create config and memory files.

commands.name: scan
commands.description: Quick read-only health report across all active lenses — code complexity, labelling, docs coverage.

commands.name: run
commands.description: Autonomous work loop — scan across lenses, pick highest-priority targets, dispatch to agents, create focused PRs.

commands.name: sleep
commands.description: Memory consolidation — promote proven patterns to encyclopedia, prune short-term memory, generate morning briefing.

commands.name: deploy
commands.description: Generate tmux/bash scripts for autonomous background running. Interactive setup for daemon configuration.

commands.name: help
commands.description: Brief visual overview of how keeper works, plus interactive Q&A.

commands.name: lib:readme
commands.description: Regenerate README.md by running keeper on itself and capturing real terminal output for the User Journey section.
